hw_name.description: This is the VESC Logging and Communication Module.

balance_enabled.description: Enable/disable balancing. Turn it off to experiment with base motor settings without the balance interfering.

error_linear_limit.description:
PID error is calculated using this function (desmos):


y = x { 0<x<d }

y = k ln( (x-d)/k +1 ) + d, { x >= d }


Where y is the error; x is the pitch in degrees.


It starts linear up to a limit and then descreses logarithmically with a specific slope.


This parameter controls d

error_ln_slope.description:
PID error is calculated using this function (desmos):


y = x { 0<x<d }

y = k ln( (x-d)/k +1 ) + d, { x >= d }


Where y is the error; x is the pitch in degrees.


It starts linear up to a limit and then descreses logarithmically with a specific slope.


This parameter controls k

pid_mode.description:
PID loop mode, Angle or Cascadeing Angle Rate.


Alternative (alt) mode changes the way proportional component is calculated. In the original cascade mode the rate P parameter directly affects the first PID value. It means that every adjustment to rate P requires corresponding adjustment to the angle P to keed the same "pedal stiffness" at constant angle. In alternative mode it only affects the error (0 - gyro_y) of the second PID which allows tuning the second part without touching the behavior of the first one.


Additionally alt mode adds the deadzone, making the regulator engange only after specific gyro_y threshold.

kp.description: P value for the PID balance loop.

kexp.description:
Exponential component defined as e^(kx) - 1


This parameter controls the "steepness" of the exponent, k

ki.description: I value for the PID balance loop.

kd.description: D value for the PID balance loop.

pid2_deadzone.description: Rate PID deadzone. Shifts the regulator error (0 - gyro_y) by this value (in °/s) delaying its effect.

kp2.description: P value for the PID balance loop.

ki2.description: I value for the PID balance loop.

kd2.description: D value for the PID balance loop.

hertz.description: Loop Hertz.

loop_time_filter.description: Filter overshoot and correct for it.

fault_pitch.description: Angle to turn off driving (on the pitch axis).

fault_roll.description: Angle to turn off driving (on the roll axis).

fault_duty.description: Duty cycle value to trigger a safety cutoff 0-1% (This cutoff will lock the app untill another fault occurs).

fault_delay_pitch.description: Pitch fault cutoff time delay in ms.

fault_delay_roll.description: Roll fault cutoff time delay in ms.

fault_delay_duty.description: Duty cycle cutoff time delay in ms.

tiltback_enabled.description: Enable/disable tilbacks completely. Bulletproof way to disable tiltbacks in case of any bugs in the implementation - omits the whole function call which does tiltbacks processing.

tiltback_return_speed.description: Speed at which vehicle is being returned back to normal after a tiltback condition has been cleared (should be equal to or slower than slowest tiltback speed).

tiltback_duty_angle.description: Angle of rise for duty cycle tiltback.

tiltback_duty_speed.description: Speed at which vehicle is being tilted back when exceeding duty cycle limit (fast tiltback can be dangerous!).

tiltback_duty.description: Duty cycle threshold to trigger a safety tiltback (Tiltback raises the nose of the vehicle informing you to slow down).

tiltback_hv_angle.description: Angle of rise for high voltage tiltback.

tiltback_hv_speed.description: Speed at which vehicle is being tilted back when exceeding high voltage limit (fast tiltback can be dangerous!).

tiltback_hv.description: High voltage threshold to trigger a safety tiltback (Tiltback raises the nose of the vehicle to alert you). High voltage tiltback is most likely to be triggered when braking or going downhill on a full battery, sometimes resulting in a tail drag on board shaped vehicles.

tiltback_lv_angle.description: Angle of rise for low voltage tiltback.

tiltback_lv_speed.description: Speed at which vehicle is being tilted back when below low voltage threshold (fast tiltback can be dangerous and further contribute to voltage sag!).

tiltback_lv.description: Low voltage threshold to trigger a safety tiltback (Tiltback raises the nose of the vehicle informing you to slow down).

startup_pitch_tolerance.description: Angle at which balancing will start (on the main axis). Measured in degrees from upright (0).

startup_roll_tolerance.description: Angle at which balancing will start (on the cross axis). Measured in degrees from upright (0).

startup_speed.description: Speed at which wheel will center itself on startup.

brake_current.description: Breaking current to be applied when balance app is not actively balancing.

brake_timeout.description: Turn off the brake after this many seconds. It will automatically reactivate if the motor moves. 0 = Disabled.

ki_limit.description: I term limiter, used to prevent windup. 0 = disabled.

kd_pt1_lowpass_frequency.longName: D term PT1 Low Pass Filter
kd_pt1_lowpass_frequency.description: D term filter above this frequency. 0 = Disabled.

kd2_pt1_lowpass_frequency.longName: Rate D term PT1 Low Pass Filter
kd2_pt1_lowpass_frequency.description: Rate D term filter above this frequency. 0 = Disabled.

kd_pt1_highpass_frequency.longName: D term PT1 High Pass Filter
kd_pt1_highpass_frequency.description: D term filter below this frequency. 0 = Disabled.

booster_angle.description: Angle at which booster is applied (actually measued as absolute deviation from setpoint).

booster_ramp.description: Degrees over which booster will ramp from 0A to the Configured Current, starting at start Angle.

booster_current.description: Extra current to be applied when booster angle is reached.

torquetilt_start_current.description: Minimum output current threshold for torque tiltback to start applying.

torquetilt_angle_limit.description: Max angle to which torque tiltback will tilt.

torquetilt_on_speed.description: Max speed at which torque tiltback will tilt to the desired angle (tilt will be slower if current increases slowly).

torquetilt_off_speed.description: Max speed at which torque tiltback will release to the desired angle back to 0 (tilt will be slower if current decreases slowly).

torquetilt_strength.description: How much tiltback should be applied based on output current.

torquetilt_filter.description: Biquad Low pass filter on the current used for calculating the torquetilt. This smooths out spikes in the current, and prevents torquetilt from being twitchy.

turntilt_strength.description: How much tiltback should be applied based on the sine of the roll angle. A strength value of N will give N degrees of tiltback when the vehicle is rolled to 90 degrees.

turntilt_angle_limit.description: Max angle to which turn tiltback will tilt. This wont change the power curve, only stop it at the limit.

turntilt_start_angle.description: Min angle threshold to apply turntilt. Similar to a deadzone, except after reaching the angle, it will apply as if it started from 0.

turntilt_start_erpm.description: ERPM threshold to apply turntilt.

turntilt_speed.description: Max speed at which turntilt will tilt to the desired angle (tilt will be slower if roll angle increases slowly).

turntilt_erpm_boost.description: Increase the strength based on ERPM. Boost percent is added linearly from 0 erpm (0% boost) to max erpm (Full configured boost % is applied).

turntilt_erpm_boost_end.description: ERPM (absolute value) to end boosting the turn tilt effect, above this erpm there will be constant boost % (at your configured boost %).

setpoint_min.description: Absolute minimum value allowed for the setpoint. Any setpoint change will stop at this point.

setpoint_max.description: Absolute maximum value allowed for the setpoint. Any setpoint change will stop at this point.

setpoint_constant.description:
Setpoint adjustment (tilt) by a constant value in degrees. Positive value increases the pitch angle tilting the PEV up. Negative value decreases the pitch angle tilting the PEV down.


All setpoint adjustments do not go below Setpoint min or above Setpoint max values.

setpoint_change_rate.description: Speed at which setpoint changes will go towards chaning target

setpoint_speed_based.description:
Setpoint adjustment (tilt) that will be applied depending on speed, specified in degrees per 1000 erpm, applied linearly. Can be downwards (negative) too. Applies in addition to constant tiltback.


All setpoint adjustments do not go below Setpoint min or above Setpoint max values.

setpoint_speed_based_deadzone.description: Deadzone for speed based setpoint adjustment.
